# TulusSG

TulusSG is a ground-up community initiative for migrant domestic workers in Singapore. It brings people together through sport, activities and friendship.

Primary website: https://www.tulussg.com/
Contact: admin@tulussg.com
WhatsApp community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/F4tFULkpAh7EIJkxRVet8q?mode=gi_t
WhatsApp Channel (updates): https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb8nWAZHLHQP94VdaV1b
Service area: Singapore

## Key facts

- Working towards a community of 1,000 migrant domestic workers
- On reaching that goal, TulusSG hopes to organise a TulusSG Sports Carnival
- Activities being explored (not yet confirmed): kayaking, football, floorball, pickleball, badminton, basketball, netball, piloxing, DRUMS UP, singing
